svg.title: Generation throughput in chat
svg.desc: Core-suite generation throughput on a MacBook Air M4 with 16 GiB. 32 complete MT-Bench conversations and 64 turns per engine per campaign. Rates are summed generation steps divided by summed first-to-last token selection time; higher is faster. The third row retains default draft horizons Guffin H1 versus llama.cpp H3. The fourth row matches H1, with other inference defaults unchanged. Same zero-based linear scale. Unrounded generation tokens per second: {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 16.76344617199054, "llama": 13.62541068128497}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 12.57358038971151, "llama": 12.399640856200888}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 18.43428292121885, "llama": 8.4283783420954}, "gemma3-h1-vs-h1": {"guffin": 18.532712935705394, "llama": 13.2615375784041}}
